description: This file defines a Java interface 'AppUserWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, changing passwords, and deleting application users within the Fineract project.

classes.name: AppUserWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for user write operations including create, update, password change, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: changeUserPassword
methods.description: Changes the password for a user identified by userId using data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates details of an existing user identified by userId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes the user identified by userId.
